falseSynonyms.word: in that sense / from that perspective
falseSynonyms.zh: 兩者高度接近；from that perspective 更明確表示 viewpoint，而 in that sense 也可只是限定某一方面或某種解讀。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON From that perspective, the delay was useful. In that sense, the two cases are similar.

falseSynonyms.word: in that sense / in that respect
falseSynonyms.zh: in that respect 明確指一個 aspect / feature；in that sense 可以更抽象地表示『如果那樣理解』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The models are similar in that respect. In that sense, the failure was useful.

falseSynonyms.word: in that sense / in that regard
falseSynonyms.zh: in that regard 較正式，常回指某個已提及的 policy issue / concern；in that sense 更廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The company improved in that regard. In that sense, the argument is persuasive.

falseSynonyms.zh: therefore 表示邏輯結果『因此』；in that sense 只限定評價角度，兩者不能互換。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Costs fell; therefore, profits rose. In that sense, the reform succeeded.

falseSynonyms.word: in that sense / in other words
falseSynonyms.zh: in other words 是重新表述同一內容；in that sense 是限定理解或評價方式。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON In other words, the rule applies to everyone. In that sense, the rule is fair.

falseSynonyms.word: in that sense / to that extent
falseSynonyms.zh: to that extent 表示『到那個程度』，較偏 degree；in that sense 偏 interpretation / respect。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON To that extent, the criticism is justified. In that sense, the two ideas overlap.

falseSynonyms.word: in that sense / on that interpretation
falseSynonyms.zh: on that interpretation 只在 wording/rules/texts 有特定解讀時最精確；一般觀點不一定叫 interpretation。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON On that interpretation, the clause applies. In that sense, the project was successful.

falseSynonyms.zh: sense 單獨是名詞，可指感官、意義、判斷力等；固定片語 in that sense 不能被單獨 sense 取代。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The word has several senses. In that sense, the statement is correct.
